title: Lottery
tagline: A decentralized raffle / lottery that randomly chooses a winner on chain.
description: This project combines a website front-end that allows users to enter the raffle by paying the entrance fee, and chainlink's vrf & keepers to choose a tamper-proof lottery winner. This project uses nextjs on the frontend, with web3uikit to connect to a backend built with solidity and chainlinks vrf & keepers.
